lines.text: In distress the writer cried to the LORD, and He answered.
The writer asks the LORD to deliver his soul from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the olive tree.
The writer laments dwelling in Meshech and living among the tents of Midian.
The writer has dwelt too long among those who hate peace, and they want war when he speaks.
